claim_ledger.evidence: A08.md section 5 infimum proof; exact cost-halving controls
claim_ledger.next_falsifier: An F-image uses inaccessible resources or costs more than its source arrow
claim_ledger.quantifier: Every arrow and every pair of objects

claim_ledger.evidence: X-Y=1,Y-Z=1,X-Z=2+r for r>0; absent reset gives infinity
claim_ledger.repair: Retain resource state or explicitly price representative transfer
